text:
Type: yellow and grey knitted throw
Use: keeping warm on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, contemporary, retro
Materials: chunky knit cotton with a textured bubble stitch, ribbed solid border
Colors: mustard yellow, light grey, white
Shape: long rectangle with fine horizontal stripes of nubby knit, wide ribbed mustard band at the ends, soft drape, medium weight
Feel: cozy, cheerful, warm
Goes with: grey or white sofas, light wood, mustard accents, wool textures; Scandinavian or contemporary living rooms
